items.title: Trump and Iran's negotiator trade warnings as talks held in Switzerland
items.description: The US president, who is not at the talks, threatens to attack Iran if it does not restrain Hezbollah in Lebanon.

items.title: Fuel sales halted in occupied Crimea as Ukraine targets oil facilities
items.description: Fuel had already been rationed due to shortages caused by Kyiv's attacks against supply routes in Russian-occupied territories.

items.title: Ethiopia PM's party wins landslide as fears grow of new conflict
items.description: Abiy Ahmed's party retains its huge majority despite unrest in several parts of Ethiopia and tensions with its neighbours.

items.title: Half of France under red heat alert as alcohol banned at street music festival
items.description: Temperatures are forecast to peak on Monday, and authorities warn they could match historic highs.

items.title: Colombia's escalating, brutal internal conflict is defining its presidential election
items.description: A left-wing senator who backs talks with armed gangs faces an outsider endorsed by Trump.

items.title: Former Olympian denies vandalising Washington Reflecting Pool after arrest
items.description: Davey Hearn says he was simply touching the new paint at the site out of curiosity and did not remove or alter it.

items.title: Tight security as Indian students resit medical exam after alleged paper leak
items.description: Millions of candidates face biometric checks and frisking as air force deployed to secure exam papers.

items.title: Israeli strikes kill six people in Gaza including Al Jazeera cameraman, officials say
items.description: The Israeli military accused Ahmed Wishah of being a "Hamas sniper operative", without providing evidence.

items.title: Low-key funeral held for giant of the art world David Hockney
items.description: The artist, who passed away at his home in London earlier this month, requested just his partner and great-nephew attend.

items.title: Dutch royals enjoy two big results in one World Cup day
items.description: There may be about 5,000 miles between the Netherlands and their former colony Curacao but members of the Dutch royal family managed to see both sides play on Saturday.

items.title: African and Caribbean nations call for formal apology for transatlantic slavery
items.description: The leaders have asked for apologies from the countries that benefited from the slave trade, as well as debt relief and financial compensation.

items.title: Indian cricketer, 15, hits record-breaking 50 in just 11 balls
items.description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi breaks the record for the fastest 50-over List A half-century in history on the same day he was not included in India's one-day international squad.
